notes.title: Steam Fest Announcement
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42585062/04c96ea06f1c3f36ccfc4aa2675e39950357f64d.png


The Creepy Syndrome, the new horror game created by Boomfire Games and published by JanduSoft, will have a demo available at the upcoming Steam Next Fest.

 

The Creepy Syndrome is an anthology of horror games. It will consist of various psychological horror stories with different pixel art styles: from a retro 1-bit style, to 8-bit, gameboy style visuals, etc. 
 

All the stories are connected to each other. They belong to the same character whose disturbed mind will be analyzed by a mysterious psychiatrist.

 

Enter the madness through different stories

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42585062/a1a285b6775f72fe9b9e90a6152b20175860b56a.gif


A new horror experience in different pixel-art styles
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42585062/244ade70df4dbf752183c4f4728f49b72343218a.gif

In this demo of The Creepy Syndrome you will play two different stories with a unique pixel-art style. In "Lords of the Road" you will find an exploration game based in the region of Cordoba, a beautiful Spanish city where horrible events are happening.

 

You will also be able to play a part of "The Red Button". A completely different story with a pixel-art style that reminds of the old Point 'n Click adventure games. It will take place in a bunker where difficult decisions will be made. Are you prepared for the terrible consequences?.
 

Don't miss the streaming with the devs

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42585062/b5ac90b3d4703a12ddaec470cce053b0c2c2277f.png

During the week of Steam Next Fest we will stream a talk with Boomfire Games where they will give us more information about The Creepy Syndrome. It will be available on the game's Steam page. Don't forget to add The Creepy Syndrome to your Steam wishlist.
